topic: As AI eats the web, the internet’s collective memory is disappearing
headline: The Vanishing Web Memory
caption: As a full stack developer, I see the Web's collective memory shrinking firsthand. AI models often train on static data, but how much of our online history will vanish as AI consumes more content? Preserving the web’s memory means investing in better data curation and archival methods. Staying aware of these shifts helps us build more resilient and transparent applications. It’s an exciting yet challenging time for developers to innovate around knowledge preservation. Let’s ensure our digital history stays accessible for future generations. 💻 #WebDevelopment #AIEvolution #DataArchiving
